name: Chest Doorway Stretch

instructions.description: Stand in a doorway or beside a wall and place your forearm against the frame with the elbow around shoulder height.
Step forward gently with the same-side leg or rotate the body slightly away from the arm.
Feel a stretch across the front of the chest and shoulder while keeping the shoulder down.
Return slowly and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a mild to moderate stretch intensity.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Lie lengthwise on a foam roller to open the chest in a supported way.

commentsNotes: Do not push into front-shoulder pain.
Vary arm height slightly to change the stretch angle.
